cases.name: leases
cases.fairness: Temporal liveness obligations explicitly imply the original per-action Fairness predicate. Step includes stuttering; nextStep preserves the original enabled relation.

assumptions: Checked formula in InteractionSession_leases: EffectOnlyByCommitter = always((next(s.effects) != s.effects implies Clients.exists(c => s.pc.get(c) == "committed" and next(s.pc.get(c)) == "executed")).orKeep(s))
No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
Checked formula in InteractionSession_leases: EffectRecorded = Fairness implies (s.effects == 1 leadsTo s.reached == "completed")
Model fairness predicate Fairness = Reconcile.weakFair(s) and Clients.forall(c => Commit(c).weakFair(s) and Execute(c).weakFair(s) and Complete(c).weakFair(s))
The stated fairness is an assumption about enabled model actions; runtime scheduling and provider completion are not proved.
Checked formula in InteractionSession_leases: DeadlockFree = always(enabled(nextStep))
No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
